 Our Story Menu Catering We're Hiring Gift Cards Music Contact Us Best Seafood in Orange Beach Where Coastal Flavors Meet Vibrant Culinary Adventure Order online Welcome to OSO at Bear Point Harbor - Orange BeachAt OSO, “bear” isn’t just a name it’s a flavor adventure. Inspired by the vibrant coastlines from Florida to Mexico, our Coastal Cuisine brings fresh, bold, and unforgettable tastes to your table. From locally sourced seafood to inventive dishes bursting with flavor, every meal is a celebration of the coast.
